title: Administrator
description:
Job Title: Administrator

Hours: Monday - Friday 8am-4pm, 37.5 hours per week

Location: Doncaster & Bassetlaw Teaching Hospitals NHS FT

Trust Location: Doncaster Royal Infirmary, Armthorpe Road, Doncaster, DN2 5 LT - Hybrid working available - 2/3 days in the office, the rest at home.

Contract Type: Temporary for 6 months

Reference: 91616

What you ll be responsible for:
- Organise meetings, agendas and papers.
- Attend meetings and produce accurate minutes and action logs.
- Track and follow up actions arising from meetings.
- Manage shared inboxes and respond to routine enquiries.
- Maintain records, trackers and documentation.

You ll learn the following whilst working at the trust:
- An in depth understanding of the roles and responsibilities involved in working within the NHS.
- Knowledge of the systems used, to effectively complete your role to the highest standard at all times.
- A sense of teamwork, gained through working alongside and supporting colleagues from all levels, within the organisation.

You ll have the following skills/experience:
- Previous experience of working in an administrative role.
- Previous experience of minute taking.
- Previous experience of using Microsoft 365.

This role may require you to show evidence of vocational level 3 qualification or at least 2 years relevant experience.

As a member of NHS Professionals, you have fantastic benefits:
- Competitive pay rates- work this week, get paid next week
- Essential support when you need it- 24/7 365 days- call us anytime
- Multi locational- work across neighbouring Trusts
- Manage your shifts and timesheets on the go- access your My Bank shift portal anywhere, anytime online or through your smartphone
- Varied working options to suit your lifestyle- access to the Bank gives you options of ad hoc shifts or longer-term placements
- Training and development opportunities- Keep up with the essentials and more
- Build holiday allowance for every shift you work- your work life balance is important to us
- Stakeholder pension scheme available- a flexible future for you and yours

Who are NHS Professionals?

We specialise in putting people in place to care. Every year we help thousands of dedicated candidates and highly skilled NHS workers enjoy better career opportunities, access to more shifts and a healthier work-life balance, giving more choice and control to our members.

As an equal opportunities organisation, NHSP is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective Bank members and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender reassignment, or marriage and civil partnership. We believe there is a strong case for the Equality, Diversity and inclusion agenda and we strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants form a range of backgrounds to apply.

Apply Today

By joining us you can look forward to a choice of flexible Bank shifts across any of our client Trusts in England, as well as the ability to develop professionally and gain experience in several wards or areas.

Disclaimer

Please note, you will be contacted by email throughout the recruitment process, so please check your emails, including your junk/spam regularly. We regret we cannot contact everyone who is not selected for an interview, therefore if you do not hear from us within 21 days after submitting your application, please assume you have not been successful on this occasion.

NHS Professionals manage your data, please see our Privacy Notice on our website.

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Sharp Consultancy is currently recruiting for an Assistant Accountant to join a growing finance team based in Doncaster.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant looking to take the next step in their career and gain further exposure across a broad range of accounting duties, whilst benefiting from a hybrid working pattern.

Working closely with the wider finance team, you will be involved in the day-to-day running of the accounts function, supporting with month-end and ensuring the financial information is accurate and up to date.

Key responsibilities
- Supporting with month-end processes and reporting
- Preparing and posting journals
- Bank and balance sheet reconciliations
- Accruals and prepayments
- Supporting with accounts payable and receivable
- Assisting with VAT returns
- Maintaining accurate financial records
- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad-hoc reporting and analysis

About you

We're looking for someone with previous experience within an accounts or finance environment who is keen to develop their knowledge and take on more responsibility.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant position
- Good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping
- Experience with reconciliations, journals, accruals and prepayments
- Strong Excel skills
- Good attention to detail and a methodical approach
- Excellent communication skills
- The ability to work independently while also contributing to a wider finance team
- AAT study or a desire to progress with your accounting qualifications would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Why apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive finance team in Doncaster, offering a hybrid working pattern and salary of up to £35,000.

If you're an Accounts Assistant looking for more responsibility, or an Assistant Accountant looking for a new challenge, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator

Doncaster
30,000 per annum + excellent benefits
Full-Time Permanent

Our client, a well-established organisation based in Doncaster, is looking to recruit a Customer Service Administrator to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis.

Working Hours:
- Monday to Thursday: 8:00am to 5:00pm
- Friday: 8:00am to 4:30pm

The Role

As a Customer Service Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering an excellent after-sales experience, ensuring customer enquiries are handled professionally and efficiently from initial contact through to resolution. The role will also involve supporting day-to-day sales administration activities, including processing orders, preparing quotations and coordinating schedules.

Duties and Responsibilities
- Deliver first-class support to customers by handling after sales enquiries via telephone and email.
- Assist customers with a range of issues including product concerns, repairs, replacements, returns and warranty-related matters.
- Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process, ensuring communication is accurate, professional and timely.
- Process customer orders and quotations, ensuring all information is accurate and completed within agreed timeframes.
- Coordinate schedules and liaise with internal teams to support the smooth delivery of products and services.
- Maintain and update company databases and internal systems with relevant customer information and case details.
- Work closely with internal teams to identify the root cause of customer concerns and help drive effective solutions.
- Arrange and oversee remedial actions, including coordinating repairs and replacement products where necessary.
- Refer more complex or sensitive cases to senior management for further guidance and resolution.
- Monitor the progress of returned items and warranty claims, ensuring cases are concluded efficiently.
- Compile and analyse after-sales data, producing reports on customer complaints, returns activity, warranty performance and response metrics.

The Successful Candidate
- Previous experience within a customer service and/or administrative role is essential.
- Experience within a manufacturing, engineering or technical environment would be highly advantageous.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications & ERP / MRP systems.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary of 30,000 per annum.
- Excellent benefits package.
- Permanent, full-time opportunity.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to join a successful and growing business.

To apply or find out more about this opportunity, please get in touch today.

Office Angels is an employment agency and business. We are an equal-opportunities employer who puts expertise, energy and enthusiasm into improving everyone's chance of being part of the workplace. We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities and more. By showcasing talents, skills and unique experiences in an inclusive environment, we help individuals thrive. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Office Angels acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. Office Angels UK is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Office Angels. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Customer Service Adviser
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Trax Park, Doncaster

Hours: Full time, 37 hours per week

Salary: 27,715, plus 33 days holiday (including bank holidays), pension, life assurance, employee assistance programme, wellbeing support, and flexible benefits including cycle to work scheme

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join our team in Doncaster. In this key role, you'll be the first point of contact for a portfolio of our Customer Accounts, helping to resolve queries, process orders, and ensure we're delivering exceptional service. If you enjoy problem-solving, working in a collaborative environment, and making a real impact on the customer experience, this role is for you.

As part of your key responsibilities, you'll:
- Act as the first point of contact for a portfolio of Customer Accounts, resolving queries and building strong customer relationships
- Handle pricing, delivery information, and order processing from end to end
- Drive customer satisfaction and manage key customer enquiries
- Collaborate with departments across the business to troubleshoot issues and handle complaints professionally
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure swift problem resolution within agreed SLAs
- Maintain accurate records and recognise patterns in service failures
- Support business improvement activity to design and implement processes that maximise operational performance and improve customer engagement

About You

We'd love you to have the following skills and experience, but please apply if you think you'd be able to perform well in this role!
- Previous experience in a customer service or support role, ideally within a fast-paced, transactional environment
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships and deliver high-quality, customer-focused solutions
- Understanding of the rail or logistics sector, alongside experience working with e-commerce or B2 B customer platforms (a distinct advantage)
- Proven ability to meet tight deadlines, with great organisation and time-management skills
- Strong contract and commercial awareness, including knowledge of commercial terms and conditions (highly beneficial)
- English and Maths GCSEs (or equivalent), backed by good analytical skills to understand and interpret data
- Confident IT skills, particularly a strong working knowledge of Google Workspace and SAP

About Unipart

We are a supply chain performance improvement partner. We Design, Make, Move, and Improve components in our customers' supply chains, keeping their operations and assets moving and working better, for longer. Through our commitment to continuously driving operational efficiencies, we improve performance - saving time, cost, and carbon. Our ambition is to be the driving force behind efficient, resilient, and sustainable supply chains.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

We believe that a great workplace is one where you can bring your whole self to work. Our recruitment process is designed to be accessible, inclusive, and based entirely on merit. We define merit through a combination of technical skills and the core behaviours that help our people thrive at Unipart. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of background or circumstances. We are committed to a policy of equal opportunity that exceeds our statutory obligations under the Equality Act 2010 and subsequent legislation. Whether it's your age, disability, neurodiversity, gender identity, family status, or any other characteristic that makes you 'you' - it is your talent and potential that we value most. Adjustments for you: We want you to perform at your best. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

You may have experience in the following: Customer Service Advisor, Customer Service Representative, Customer Support, Customer Care, Account Handler, Order Processing, Order Desk, Sales Support, Sales Administrator, Customer Account Coordinator, Customer Experience, Complaints Handling, Logistics, Rail, B2 B, E-commerce, SAP, Google Workspace

title: Graduate Administrator
description:
Graduate Administrator

Location: Doncaster
Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 per annum
Hours: Full-time, 8:30am 5:00pm, office-based

Our client is looking for an enthusiastic and committed Graduate Administrator to join their stable and friendly team in Doncaster.

This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate looking to start or develop a career within accounts and administration. Full training and support will be provided, making this an ideal opportunity for a recent graduate who is keen to learn and develop their skills within a professional business environment.

The successful candidate will have a positive attitude, be self-motivated, willing to learn and able to work effectively as part of a team.

The position has become available following the retirement of a long-standing member of the team, highlighting the stability and supportive environment within the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Prepare delivery notes, scan documentation and complete the daily invoicing process.
- Process credit notes.
- Prepare the weekly payment run and payment reports.
- Provide general administration and accounts support when required.
- Assist with credit limits and customer or sales team account queries.
- Update Sage accounting systems on a daily basis.
- Prepare and process supplier payments.
- Complete the weekly cash book.
- Analyse and update sales information.
- Reconcile bank accounts and Sage accounts on a monthly basis.
- Create recharge invoices for inter-company transactions.
- Provide additional administrative and accounts support to the team as required.

Person Specification

The successful candidate will have:
- A degree-level qualification.
- A positive and self-motivated attitude.
- The ability to work independently and use their own initiative.
- Strong concentration and analytical skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- A conscientious and reliable approach to work.
- Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
- Excellent IT skills.
- A willingness to learn and develop a career within accounts.

Benefits
- £26,000 - £28,000 annual salary.

title: HR Assistant
company: Andy File Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Andy File Associates Limited is working as a Recruitment Agency on behalf of our client with regards this permanent position.

We re looking for an HR Assistant to join our client and provide hands-on support across a broad range of HR activities.

Hours of work: Monday to Friday 8.30am to 5.00pm

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised, people-focused individual who enjoys working in a busy environment and is looking to develop their HR career within a supportive team.

What will you be doing?

You ll play an important role in keeping the HR function running smoothly, supporting the full employee lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
- Being able to liaise with the HR advisors and follow the recommendations given.
- Recruitment process from advertising, interview administration, references, induction and exit process.
- Authorise, record, and provide statistics on holidays, attendance, and payroll.
- Note taking for meetings.
- Conduct investigations and meetings. Liaising with line managers when reviews are due.
- Administer absence records and investigations.

description:

title: Production Administrator
description:
Production Planning Assistant

Location: Coulman Road, Thorne, Doncaster, South Yorkshire

Salary: £13.50 per hour

Overview:

The Production Planning Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the production team, ensuring manufacturing processes run efficiently, documentation is accurate, and deadlines are met. The role acts as a key link between production, planning, quality, and other departments.

Duties:
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the production department
- Maintain accurate production records, reports, and databases
- Raise and process production paperwork (work orders, schedules, dispatch notes, etc.)
- Monitor production schedules and flag delays or issues to supervisors
- Coordinate with planning, warehouse, quality, and dispatch teams
- Input data into production systems and spreadsheets accurately and on time
- Support stock control activities, including raw materials and finished goods records
- Assist with compliance documentation (e.g. audits, health & safety, quality standards)
- Handle general office duties such as filing, scanning, and email correspondence
- Support continuous improvement and efficiency initiatives
- Conduct cyclical stock counts, ensuring a high level of data accuracy in line with operational requirements.

Qualifications / Experience:
- Previous experience in an administrative role (production/manufacturing environment desirable)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths (essential)
- Experience with ERP or production systems (desirable, not essential)
- Knowledge of manufacturing or factory operations (advantageous)

Key Qualities
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Confident using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- Good communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
- Problem-solving mindset
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Working Conditions
- Office based in Production area with regular interaction with the production floor
- Monday - Friday with 15:00 midnight shifts

Please note -The environment is working in a food production facility and as such is cold (3 degrees). PPE is provided, however, it is still very cold.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Chesterfield Poultry Ltd, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and compassionate receptionist to join our busy GP Practice. As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play a key role in providing excellent customer service while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. You will work as part of a dedicated team, handling a variety of administrative and receptionist duties in a fast-paced healthcare environment. The normal duties of the role will consist of: Act as the first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Answer telephone calls promptly, dealing with enquiries efficiently and directing them to the appropriate member of the team as required. Welcome patients, check them in for appointments, and manage the reception area. Book, amend and cancel appointments as required. Signposting patients to appropriate services. General use of clinical system - SystmOne Process repeat prescription requests. General administration tasks such as processing new registrations, summarising medical records, distributing incoming mail, dealing with emails. Liaise with GPs, nurses and other members of the team. Any other duties as required. SystmOne experience is essential for this post. The post is for 18 hours with the opportunity for additional hours. Hours will be discussed at interview. This vacancy may close earlier than the advertised closing date if a sufficient number of applications are received. Previous applicants need not apply.

To undertake general reception tasks & other administration duties To work within a telephone hub and front desk environment. To work along side a team of professional people. Problem Solving IT and keyboard skills Ability to handle conflict Administration tasks Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice. Receive, assist and direct patients to the appropriate healthcare professional. Telephones are answered within a timely fashion and patients/queries are navigated to the correct service.
